About
Background

Fifteen-plus years in learning technology and capability, with the past decade focused on digital learning, platform implementation, and now enterprise AI capability and fluency. I have worked on both sides of the vendor/client relationship: six-plus years at a global LMS company, the last three running the Australian business as Director, then leading learning technology and AI capability at EY Oceania. I design and scale learning programmes that deliver measurable outcomes, and I bring a perspective on where learning technology is heading that most internal L&D practitioners don't have.
